title: FrankenSymPy conformance discrepancy record
description: One blocking or recorded mismatch between an oracle observation envelope and a candidate observation envelope. Shape follows docs/FIRST_IMPLEMENTATION_CAMPAIGN.md section 19 (discrepancy policy) and docs/CONFORMANCE_AND_BENCHMARKING.md section 7.3. Unknown fields are rejected by consumers (fail closed).

discrepancy_id.description: Stable id; derived content hash when auto-minimized.

status.description: 'will fix later' is deliberately NOT representable; closure requires gate evidence.

comparator.description: Registry id of the comparator that produced this discrepancy.

outcome_classes.description: Present when returned/raised classification itself differs.

path.description: Dotted path inside the observation envelope, minimized to the first differing component boundary.

environment.description: Oracle environment fingerprint copied verbatim from the envelopes.

closure_test.description: Command or fixture id whose green run closes this discrepancy.
